title: Convergence of the critical probabilities for stopping near the top of a random walk
summary: Let \((S_n)_{n\ge0}\) be a Bernoulli random walk with \(P(X_i=1)=p\) and \(P(X_i=-1)=q=1-p\), and let \(M_n=\max\{S_0,\ldots,S_n\}\). We consider the semi-best selection problem of maximizing \(P(M_N-S_τ\le1)\) over stopping times \(τ\le N\). Allaart showed that the optimal decision in the critical state \((n,1)\) is determined by critical probabilities \(p_n\), and conjectured that \(p_n\to1/2\). In this note, we prove this conjecture.
